text:
Rhea (Growth): Quick sync — launch week plan for newsletter/drip: we run a three-tier nurture over 72h: 1) teaser + benchmark, 2) launch + CTA (demo slots), 3) webinar invite + recording RSVP. Keep each email <100 words.

Priya (Content): Got it. I'll write micro-copy variants for each tier: benchmark-led, product-led, and story-led. Two subject variants per tier.

Ivy (Email Ops): Proposed send windows (ET): Teaser 10:00am, Launch 2:00pm, Webinar invite next day 11:00am. Throttle ramp on launch send. Need suppression and exact segment CSV.

Noah (Analytics): Segment priority: recent signups (7d), engaged trialers (used >2 features), and NPS promoters. Controls: weekly digest subscribers only. We'll keep 5% unseen holdout for attribution.

Tom (Paid): For paid retargeting, show benchmark creative on socials tied to the teaser email. Use audience seed from engaged trialers.

Rhea (Growth): CTA hierarchy: demo claim > webinar RSVP > download report. Demo claim gets AE tag "launch_week_demo"; webinar RSVP gets nurture flow.

Priya (Content): Subject ideas: Teaser A: "New benchmark: cut LLM inference cost" Teaser B: "What your stack is costing you". Launch A: "Claim a demo: limited slots" Launch B: "See the numbers + demo".

Ivy (Email Ops): Suppression rules: global unsub, bounced in last 30d, sent >=3 in last 14d. Also exclude anyone who demo-claimed in last 90d. I'll attach the suppression export.

Noah (Analytics): Metrics to track: open, CTR, demo-claim rate, webinar-RSVP, 30d revenue lift for demo claim cohort. We'll tag events: email_open, click_benchmark, demo_claim, webinar_rsvp.

Priya (Content): Landing pages: short report page, demo booking page (with limited slots), webinar reg page. I'll add 1-line methodology on report page and a customer quote on launch page.

Ivy (Email Ops): ESP mapping: three templates, dynamic blocks per segment. A/B test subject lines (50/50) and CTA variant (benchmark vs demo) for recent signups. Holdout 5%. Sending snippet: 

```
send_ramp:
  - pct: 15
    wait: 00:04:00
  - pct: 35
    wait: 00:08:00
  - pct: 50
    wait: 00:18:00
```

Rhea (Growth): Stop criteria: if unsubscribe >0.5% or bounce spike >0.2% during ramp. If issues, pause and revert to single newsletter.

Tom (Paid): Tracking: append utm_source=email&utm_medium=launch_week&utm_campaign=173999. I'll also push creative to ad ops by EOD.

Noah (Analytics): Quick ask — create a dashboard with cohort breakdown by segment and by variant. Include time-to-demo metric.

Priya (Content): I'll post copy drafts here by tomorrow noon. Short, punchy. 2 CTAs per email at most.

Ivy (Email Ops): I'll run ISP seed tests Fri morning + provide deliverability notes. Also will set reply-to to support@redwood.ai for webinar questions.

marketing-bot: Preview links generated: teaser https://redwood.ai/preview/173999_teaser (valid 24h), launch https://redwood.ai/preview/173999_launch. Reminder set: final review at 1739993600 (Mon 9am ET).

Rhea (Growth): Cool. Action items: Priya copy, Ivy suppression + ramp, Noah dashboard, Tom ad creative. Reconvene Mon 9am ET for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:
